model.title: Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe Project Lands Restoration Act
model.meta: Indian Affairs Committee · Sen. Maria Cantwell (D-WA)

summary.text: The bill would place approximately 1,082.63 acres of federal land in Washington into trust for the Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe, adding it to the tribe's reservation. It would also prohibit gambling operations on the newly transferred land.
